text: Nobody quit this Steam demo in under ten minutes. Not one reviewer.
The median player had eleven hours in before they wrote anything.

So here's what it is. Guildrun is a PvE autobattler roguelike. You draft a team of heroes, you bend them out of the class they started in, and then you watch the fight resolve itself without touching anything.
Twenty five heroes, three hundred relics and a hundred items in the demo alone. No timer, no queue, no PvP. You think as long as you want.
Now the build. It's Unity, and I L two C P P usually hides what a team used.
Except twenty four assembly names leak out in a data file. Here's what they installed.
Sentry for crash reports. S Q Lite for three hundred relics. Zero-allocation LINQ. That's not a first project's list.
And the negative reviewers had played longer than the positive ones. Fifteen hours.
They didn't bounce. They hit the ceiling. Full teardown on the channel.
